Index.harnessWhyTitle: 经营不断拓展，业务由你掌握

plugins.title: 按需连接业务能力
plugins.description: 启用平台已开放的业务能力，通过对话配置提醒和通知，在你的权限范围内，让经营方式更合适。
plugins.imageAlt: Rental OS 归还提醒配置演示

deliverables.title: 不止回答，交付结果
deliverables.description: 准备预约报价、交接清单与经营报表，直接预览业务成果，并通过对话继续完善。

workflow.title: 重复事务，自动推进
workflow.description: 让经营简报、归还跟进和每周复盘按计划推进。掌握关键进展，需要你决定时再请求确认。

trace.title: 每次执行，有据可查
trace.description: 从理解需求、查询库存到确认提交，查看业务依据、操作过程与执行回执，每一步都清楚。
trace.imageAlt: Rental OS 预约业务执行轨迹演示

report.title: 每周经营复盘
report.prompt: 整理本周预约、交付与结算记录，生成经营复盘。
report.request: 每周五 17:00，整理本周经营情况，把需要我决定的事列出来。
report.confirmation: 「每周经营复盘」计划已准备，确认启用后按周执行。

sales.title: 晨间经营简报
sales.prompt: 汇总今日交付、归还与门店待办，生成晨间简报。
sales.request: 每天 09:00，告诉我今天有哪些交付、归还和需要关注的事。
sales.confirmation: 「晨间经营简报」计划已准备，确认启用后按日执行。

tests.title: 归还与验收跟进
tests.prompt: 整理本周到期归还与待验收订单，生成跟进清单。
tests.request: 每周一 10:00，整理本周要归还的订单，提醒我安排验收。
tests.confirmation: 「归还与验收跟进」计划已准备，确认启用后按周执行。

TracePreview.accessibleLabel: 预约执行轨迹演示：理解需求、核对权限、查询库存、生成报价、用户确认、提交预约与返回回执，可点击步骤查看依据。没有真实业务调用。
TracePreview.systemPrompt: 业务范围：当前租户 / 中心店，操作沿用正式权限。
TracePreview.userTask: 为林先生准备周末两套摄影设备的预约与报价。
TracePreview.runtimeContext: 已关联客户、租期与门店，敏感操作需用户确认。
TracePreview.assistantPlan: 先查询可租库存，再读取计价依据，准备预约草稿。
TracePreview.firstDone: 预约资料与报价已准备，等待用户确认。
TracePreview.userFollowUp: 确认按这个方案提交预约。
TracePreview.assistantSummary: 已收到用户确认，按原业务流程提交预约。
TracePreview.assistantWrapUp: 示例预约记录已返回，可通过回执追溯处理过程。
TracePreview.sample: 业务执行示例 · 无真实调用

Index.harnessWhyTitle: Your business grows. You stay in control.

plugins.title: Connect the capabilities you need
plugins.description: Configure reminders and notifications through conversation, using capabilities enabled by the platform and permitted for your role.
plugins.imageAlt: Rental OS return reminder configuration demo

deliverables.title: Beyond answers. Real work products.
deliverables.description: Prepare quotes, handover checklists and business reports. Preview the results and refine them through conversation.

workflow.title: Keep recurring work moving
workflow.description: Schedule operations briefs, return follow-ups and weekly reviews. Stay informed, with confirmation when a decision is yours.

trace.title: Every action, traceable
trace.description: From understanding a request to confirming a booking, review the business evidence, actions and receipts behind every step.
trace.imageAlt: Rental OS booking execution trace demo

PluginsPreview.accessibleLabel: Return reminder demo: check tenant capabilities and permissions, prepare the time and channel, then confirm a sample configuration. No category is created or notification sent.
PluginsPreview.prompt: Enable return reminders for location owners every day at 4 pm.
PluginsPreview.completion: The time and channel are ready. Review and confirm to enable.

toolSummaries.plan: Existing rules only; no new categories
toolSummaries.draft: Prepare a reminder configuration for review

DeliverablesPreview.accessibleLabel: Business output demo: quote, handover checklist and report cards rotate. Select a file to preview its sample content.
DeliverablesPreview.sample: Sample data · Not a business document

WorkflowPreview.accessibleLabel: Automation demo: weekly reviews, morning briefs and return follow-ups are prepared as plans for confirmation. No real task is scheduled or executed.

report.title: Weekly business review
report.prompt: Review this week’s bookings, handovers and settlements.
report.request: Every Friday at 17:00, review the business and list decisions that need me.
report.confirmation: Weekly business review is prepared. Confirm to enable the weekly schedule.

sales.title: Morning operations brief
sales.prompt: Summarize today’s handovers, returns and location tasks.
sales.request: Every day at 09:00, show me today’s handovers, returns and priorities.
sales.confirmation: Morning operations brief is prepared. Confirm to enable the daily schedule.

tests.title: Return & inspection follow-up
tests.prompt: Review this week’s due returns and outstanding inspections.
tests.request: Every Monday at 10:00, list upcoming returns and help plan inspections.
tests.confirmation: Return follow-up is prepared. Confirm to enable the weekly schedule.

WorkflowPreview.demoNote: No real schedule or notification is created.

TracePreview.accessibleLabel: Booking trace demo: review scope, stock, quote, user confirmation, booking submission and a sample receipt. Select steps to inspect evidence. No real calls are made.
TracePreview.systemPrompt: Business scope: current tenant / Central location; existing permissions apply.
TracePreview.userTask: Prepare a weekend booking and quote for Alex: two camera kits.
TracePreview.runtimeContext: Customer, dates and location linked. Sensitive actions require confirmation.
TracePreview.assistantPlan: Check availability and pricing evidence, then prepare a booking draft.
TracePreview.firstDone: Booking and quote ready for user confirmation.
TracePreview.userFollowUp: Confirm this plan and submit the booking.
TracePreview.assistantSummary: User confirmation received. Submit through the business workflow.
TracePreview.assistantWrapUp: Sample booking receipt returned. The execution remains traceable.
